stances.quote: We must continue to invest in cutting edge technologies that will preserve our military superiority and act as a deterrent against rogue states that would do us and our allies harm.
stances.reasoning: Text explicitly calls for continued investment to maintain military superiority.

stances.quote: I am committed to the idea that the hardworking families of Ohio know best how to spend their own money and that more of it should remain in their own pockets. Low taxes foster a healthier economy across the board.
stances.reasoning: Text repeatedly advocates low taxes and keeping more money in pockets.

stances.quote: The federal government spends six million dollars a minute, each minute, every day of the year. This unfettered spending costs each American family over $23,000 a year. Federal government spending is out of control, and it is the responsibility of Congress to fix the problem.
stances.reasoning: Text strongly criticizes out-of-control spending and calls for it to be reined in.

stances.quote: It is unfair that American farmers face high tariffs when exporting their products to other countries while those same countries can import their goods to the United States tariff-free. I will continue working in Congress to enact policies that strengthen Ohio’s farming base and keep it strong.
stances.reasoning: Text criticizes asymmetric tariffs and supports opening markets for fair competition.
